title: Secure SSH Configuration
story: The SSH server is insecure. Students must harden SSH by disabling root login, changing authentication settings, and limiting access.

tasks.title: Edit sshd_config
tasks.description: Open the SSH daemon configuration file for hardening.

tasks.title: Disable Root Login
tasks.description: Prevent root from logging in directly over SSH.

tasks.title: Disable Password Auth
tasks.description: Disable password authentication to require stronger SSH access methods.

tasks.title: Restart SSH
tasks.description: Restart SSH so configuration changes take effect.
tasks.hint: Restart ssh or sshd depending on the distribution.

tasks.title: Verify Config
tasks.description: Validate the effective SSH configuration after restart.
tasks.hint: Use sshd -T to inspect effective settings.
